messages:
Jordan (Customer): Hey team, getting 403s from the text-generation endpoint after our account migration. UI shows 'invalid API key' but our key works in other accounts. Started ~19:40 UTC. Can someone look? :thinking:
Alex (Support): Sorry you're hitting this — can you paste the curl you used (sanitise any secret) and the exact HTTP response body/headers?
Jordan (Customer): Here it is:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-prod-REDACTED' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-3-large","prompt":"hello"}'
```
Response: 403 {"error":"invalid api key"}
Headers: `x-request-id: rq_0a1b2c`, `x-plan-sku: enterprise-legacy`
Alex (Support): Thanks — that x-plan-sku header is interesting. Can you confirm the account id and the email? Also, did you recently switch billing plans or migrate tenants?
Jordan (Customer): Account: acct-9521, email jordan@acme.co. We migrated from legacy to the new unified plan yesterday. Billing page looks green.
Alex (Support): OK pinging eng to check logs for rq_0a1b2c and whether entitlement checks are returning an auth-style error. @Sam can you grab the request trace?
Sam (Eng): I pulled the trace. Server log shows: `auth: api_key validated` then immediately `entitlement: deny - plan.sku mismatch` — but the response body mapping layer returned `invalid api key` because of error-mapping middleware ordering. Repro steps in staging: migrate tenant -> call endpoint -> entitlement check runs and maps to 403 with generic auth message.
Maria (Billing): FYI acct-9521 had a SKU migration flag set (`migrate_to_unified=true`) but quota sync job didn't finish, so the entitlement service treats them as unentitled for a short window.
Alex (Support): So the user sees 403 invalid key even though key is fine — root cause looks like entitlement gating firing while the cache is stale. Sam, can you paste the middleware snippet showing the mapping?
Sam (Eng): Sure — current snippet (rolled out yesterday):
```py
# middleware ordering (simplified)
app.middleware('response_map')(map_errors_to_http)
app.middleware('entitlement_check')(check_entitlement)
app.middleware('auth')(validate_api_key)
```
Because map_errors_to_http runs before auth, entitlement errors get remapped into auth-like messages. Should be: auth -> entitlement -> mapping.
Alex (Support): Oof. That explains it. What's the mitigation?
Sam (Eng): Short-term: flip middleware order in the config for the affected fleet and restart rollouts. Mid-term: add structured error codes from entitlement service (e.g., 402/ENTITLEMENT_NEEDED) and avoid generic strings.
Alex (Support): Jordan, for now we can either finish the quota sync (expected to complete in ~12–18min) or we can temporarily set a bypass flag on your account so entitlement check lets calls through while we fix mapping. Which do you prefer?
Jordan (Customer): We need immediate access — put the bypass in please. Our customer workflows are blocked.
Alex (Support): On it. @Maria can you toggle bypass for acct-9521?
Maria (Billing): Done — set `entitlement_bypass=true` for acct-9521, TTL 2 hours. Please retry.
Jordan (Customer): Retried — success! No 403, generation working. Thanks. :tada:
Sam (Eng): I've queued a patch: reorder middlewares in the manifest and add a test asserting entitlement errors carry the correct structured code. Will push to canary in 15m. Patch: `ensure_order([auth, entitlement, response_map])`
DeployBot: Deploy queued: canary fleet (sha: a1b2c3) — estimated 8m to complete.
Alex (Support): Great. Action items: 1) Sam to roll the manifest fix and add tests (ENG-4257). 2) Infra to monitor for similar tenant-migration races (SRE-778). 3) Support to follow up with Jordan when canary is stable.
Sam (Eng): Patch merged to canary. Added logs to entitlement service to emit `entitlement_code` field (ENTITLEMENT_MISSING / ENTITLEMENT_OK).
Alex (Support): Jordan — I'll keep this thread open and message once fleet is fully rolled. Thanks for the quick repro steps.
Jordan (Customer): Appreciate it, Alex. Also please consider making the 403 message clearer in the future — cost us a few mins chasing keys.
Alex (Support): Agreed — ticket ENG-4258 filed to standardise error responses and avoid masking.
DeployBot: Canary deploy to fleet completed successfully.
Sam (Eng): Rollout to all fleets in progress; ETA 1h. Post-rollout we'll remove the temporary bypass.
Alex (Support): Closing loop: entitlement cache finished syncing for acct-9521, bypass removed after verifying no regression. Jordan, can you confirm everything is fine on your side?
Jordan (Customer): All good. Thanks again.
Alex (Support): Thanks everyone — tagging the follow-ups: ENG-4257, ENG-4258, SRE-778. Closing thread in 24h if no regressions. :white_check_mark:
